critical_code_review_comments: LearnChapter.js NotesPanel 'Full Topic Page' link at line ~112 uses `/${board}/${subject}/${chapter}/${topic.slug}` (legacy route) rather than /learn/... — intentional since only the legacy TopicsList/TopicPage supports per-topic pages, but keep in mind that if /learn/:board/:subject/:chapter/:topic is later added the link should be updated to the /learn/* variant for consistency.

LearnChapter.js fetches per-topic content in parallel with Promise.all — for chapters with many topics this fires N+1 requests. Consider adding a bulk endpoint GET /api/curriculum/boards/:board/:subject/:chapter?include=topics_content to fetch chapter + full topic content in a single call.

App.js keeps both /:board and /learn/:board catch-all routes — the /:board route is a very broad catch-all (single-segment path) that will match any unknown top-level path (e.g., /foobar) and try to render SubjectsList. This can mask 404s and cause confusing UX. Consider adding an explicit NotFound route or restricting /:board via a regex like /:board(igcse|as-level|a-level).

Header.js isActiveLearn checks '/boards' and '/practice' etc — but 'Live Coaching' inside the Learn dropdown points to /programs while isActiveLearn does not include '/programs'. Minor UX inconsistency: Learn tab won't highlight when on /programs even though it's a Learn dropdown item.
LearnChapter.js — unused imports (Clock, Eye, QrCode) in the icon import line; small dead-code cleanup opportunity.
